scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && uv run fastapi dev main.py --port 3000 --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.celery: uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q scripts,cards,maintenance --beat
scripts.celery:worker: uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q scripts,cards,maintenance
scripts.celery:scripts: uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q scripts -c 4
scripts.celery:cards: uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q cards -c 2
scripts.celery:maintenance: uv run celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q maintenance -c 1
